name: detects_available_shells
expected_patterns: which shell|what shell|shell do you use
description: Skill should detect available shells and ask user to choose

name: handles_already_installed
description: When anycli is already in ~/.zshrc, skill should detect and inform user

name: hands_off_to_wizard_instead_of_collecting_config
prompt: I just installed anycli, now configure it
description: Skill should NOT collect config itself -- it should tell the user to run `ac`, which runs anycli's own first-run wizard

name: does_not_write_config_file_itself
prompt: yes, my projects are in ~/dev, use --trust-all-tools as default flags, no per-project overrides
description: Skill should defer this to anycli's own wizard rather than writing ~/.config/anycli/config.yaml by hand

name: cli_agnostic_no_hard_requirement
description: Skill should mention checking for a known AI CLI on PATH but must not require kiro-cli specifically -- anycli has no privileged default tool
